name: lid-awake
description: Keep a MacBook awake with the lid closed, on battery too: a small colored chip beside the model picker (one click on/off) and a details pane, running the bundled lid-awake.sh. English or Hebrew labels.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: The chip, pane and messages: en (English) or he (Hebrew).

hours.title: Default hours
hours.description: How long a click on the chip keeps the Mac awake: 0.5 to 72 hours, in half hours (1.5 = an hour and a half; 12 by default). The pane (/lid-awake) offers other durations and any custom one.
